scope: Linux attached single-device synchronous output only; original FMQ/AIDL, Bionic, DeviceProxy and TinyALSA; unchanged public/header ABI
limits: Hardware pause unsupported and returns error; no fake success
No acoustic acceptance; external USB and input keep original paths
Blocking IO and driver errors/closure must be tested in bounded integrated runtime
